title: VIRGINIA NATIONAL BANKSHARES CORPORATION ANNOUNCES 2026 SECOND QUARTER EARNINGS AND QUARTERLY DIVIDEND
summary: Virginia National Bankshares Corporation (NASDAQ: VABK) (the "Company") today reported quarterly net income of $9.0 million, or $1.65 per diluted share, for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, compared to $4.2 million, or $0.78 per diluted share, recognized for the quarter ended June 30, 2025.
